# Sutra Haus

> Sutra Haus (Sutrahaus LLP, Bengaluru) is an independent, owner-led design and
> media studio with two practices: (1) hotels & resorts — complete website
> rebuilds with direct booking, art-directed social imagery and short-form film;
> (2) consumer brands & e-commerce — stores, product/lifestyle imagery and
> content, proven on a brand the studio built from zero. Nothing is
> template-based. The studio works worldwide; the site is available in English,
> French, German, Spanish and Italian.

## Facts

- Business name: Sutra Haus (legal: Sutrahaus LLP)
- Principal: Badal Kariwal
- Contact: badal@sutrahaus.com
- Website: https://sutrahaus.com/ (also /fr/, /de/, /es/, /it/)
- Base: Bengaluru, India — working worldwide, remote-first
- Registered Indian LLP; GST details available on request

## Practices & pages

- Hotels & resorts: https://sutrahaus.com/hotels/ — the studio takes a
  property's entire digital surface off the owner's plate: website + hosting +
  care, booking-engine integration with live direct-vs-OTA rate comparison,
  monthly art-directed imagery, short-form film, search & AI visibility, and a
  one-page monthly report.
- Consumer brands & e-commerce: https://sutrahaus.com/commerce/ — store design
  & build (Shopify and comparable), product & lifestyle imagery, brand &
  packaging direction, copy & content, film.

## Plans (names constant worldwide; pricing follows the client's market)

- The Rebuild — a complete redesign & build of the website/store, one-time.
- The Programme — The Rebuild plus a monthly supply of art-directed imagery,
  campaigns and content; monthly.
- The Partnership — an embedded studio: everything in The Programme plus
  short-form film, a standing content calendar and priority turnaround; monthly.
- Prices are shown as honest "starting from" floors per market and currency
  (USD, EUR, GBP, INR, THB, AED, SGD, JPY, AUD, CAD, CHF; USD elsewhere) and
  every proposal is scoped individually — typically 30–40% below comparable
  agency quotes for four- and five-star work in that market.
- Every conversation begins with a complimentary concept: the client's
  homepage, reimagined, before any commitment.

## Proof of work

- Hospitality: complete digital rebuild for a landmark sixty-key hotel in
  Eastern India — two websites, direct-booking flow with live OTA rate
  comparison (direct currently ~30% lower), Google Lighthouse mobile scores in
  the 90s, and 125+ original social creatives. Shown publicly in excerpts only;
  the full case is shared privately on request.
- Consumer / e-commerce: Ephoria (https://ephoria.store), a wellness brand
  built end-to-end by the studio — name, identity, packaging system,
  ten-product line, store, photography and all content.

## Policy on client work

Client websites and channels belong to the clients. The public site shows
excerpts only; the complete folio (full sites, feeds and film) is shared
privately, with permission, via badal@sutrahaus.com.

## How to engage

Email badal@sutrahaus.com. The studio studies the current website and channels,
then presents a complimentary reimagined homepage concept before any
commitment.
